item.title: Overworld 0.3.2
item.description:
• Idle residents now sit and lean. A resident who stops at the quay café sits in profile toward the table, and one who stops at a terrace wall leans against it. The café has two chairs per table.
  • The sea at dusk starts the same way every time. A fix to the sea's clock; the only visible effect is in the opening film's water on a repeated play.
  • Test-suite changes only: golden fixtures for the hook wire format and the scene snapshot, and a virtual clock for the opening timer tests. Not visible in the app.

item.title: Overworld 0.3.1
item.description:
• Finished agents now tidy away. A resident who has finished for now stands in town for ten minutes instead of thirty, each house shows at most three of them, and a house card lists the last two hours or the five most recent, with one line counting the rest. The manager card still keeps the full list.
  • The test suite no longer leaves stray browser processes behind. Not visible in the app.

sha256 d8ce06102933ab7a47495b3cb5a879e65c368e90892e619f0a5caec737273f4c

item.title: Overworld 0.3.0
item.description:
• Residents are sharper inside houses. Every class now has a sprite sheet at twice the detail, used the moment you open a house.
  • House signs and the opening title are drawn as crisp text at every zoom, the way bubbles already were. The chalk "+N" by the Hall is gone; the Hall card carries that count.
  • The remaining interior surfaces (stone, flagstones, rubble, iron, joists and the door) are redrawn at the finer detail, so a room reads evenly sharp.
  • At night, inside a house is now night: the walls take the cool dark of the hour instead of a sunset glow.
  • Residents have new poses in their sheets, leaning and sitting side-on. A stroll between terraces is built and tested but switched off in this release: no lane in today's town passes the visibility rules, so nobody strolls yet. Leaning and sitting at the café come in 0.3.1.
  • The first step toward a bigger-on-the-inside view of a house: interiors are laid out by a generator instead of fixed plans. Nothing visible changes yet.
  • The test suite runs faster and a test that could hang it is fixed. Not visible in the app.

item.title: Overworld 0.2.5
item.description:
• Fixed: the town could stop updating, and the opening film would not play at launch or from "Play the Opening", whenever an agent working outside a git repository finished for now. It now waits by the Hall as it should.

sha256 4200ad1b54ea01425a41e4b2a13c08073c63caf417e42d2e20fa2d55bb9932c2

item.title: Overworld 0.2.4
item.description:
• Fixed: speech bubbles now appear, including for agents already running when the app starts. Overworld was not reading each agent's task description, so bubbles had nothing to say. A working resident now shows its task above it in the street, or on its house's roof when it is indoors.

sha256 cb0b5c470c405f1ab2240ed1179f67b6b95a3f8ec5481e0d465bdcdc189a5820

item.title: Overworld 0.2.3
item.description:
• Fixed: if the opening film could not play, the window could stop responding to clicks and keys until relaunch. Clicks and keys now always come back within twelve seconds, Esc always works, and 'Play the Opening' is unavailable while a film is pending.

sha256 79d422d4685ddbe02a6b0a2c6affe33206db1709b1e668a06c9d94cc8b225d0a

item.title: Overworld 0.2.2
item.description:
• Overworld has a new mark: the brass bell from the town's clock tower, on the app icon, in the menu bar and in the opening title. In the menu bar it shows a slash when the hook is not installed.
  • A new notice board, opened from the Hall, lists each house's agents, working, asleep or finished for now, with the bells waiting on you first. When a manager session writes a task file, its subagents' rows also show a rough finish time.
  • If the opening film doesn't play at launch, Overworld now notes why in the system log.

sha256 629b53a6d59082d8aed5c1228718ed77b21bada5030841c6a395887b1b7cd12a

item.title: Overworld 0.2.1
item.description:
• Speech bubbles now show in the Town view, and working residents now and then show a quiet "…".
  • The Overworld title now settles in a top corner and stays a little longer. A new "Play the Opening" item replays the film: in the View menu (⌥⌘P), or from the menu-bar lamp, which opens the window first if it's closed.

sha256 915da2b9c39f88e06266f2ee143108d6cabace290b8388bfba9aad1a6321715a

item.title: Overworld 0.2.0
item.description:
• Cards can now show a task and a rough finish time. If you have a manager session write a small task file, each of its subagents' cards shows what it is working on and roughly when it expects to be done. Overworld only reads that file and never writes it.
  • Houses are drawn at twice the detail inside. Open one and the walls, floors and furniture look noticeably sharper.
  • You get a clear view into a house you open. Barrels, woodpiles and the quay lamps in front of it now disappear whole, with no slivers left behind. A hidden lamp's light and reflection go with it.
  • Speech bubbles, the sleeping "zzz", tallies and the notice board are now drawn as sharp text at every zoom level. The board's names sit on a small oak notice plate.
  • A few more cherry trees are in bloom around the village. It is a light touch.
  • The opening film now plays reliably at launch, even when the Mac is busy, the window is hidden for a moment, or you click into it early.
  • Fixed: the outline around whatever you hover over or select now clears when you move off it, leave the window, or close its card.
  • Agents who have finished for now step out of their house and wait in town, along the terrace walls or out on the pier. If the town is full, they wait in the Entrance Hall as before.

sha256 126ff58679035aab71a9b91a4d6244ad4e993d36c887b9646a89fb4182136065

item.title: Overworld 0.1.0
item.description:
• First release. Overworld shows your Claude Code agents as residents of a small town, and only watches: it never blocks, approves or changes anything in Claude Code.
  • Updates arrive on their own. Overworld checks once a day and asks nothing while you are busy; when a new version is ready, the app menu and the menu bar item read "Update to ...".
